title: CleanCash
summary: A Progressive Web App for QR-based wallet-to-wallet tipping, designed so customers can tip without installing a native application.
result: Release time reduced from hours to under 15 minutes
challenge: The product needed reliable transaction handling and a deployment process that could support frequent releases without introducing avoidable operational risk.
solution: Built wallet creation, personal QR codes and wallet-to-wallet transfer flows.
Implemented transaction processing, wallet balances and transfer history in Node.js.
Used PostgreSQL for financial data integrity.
Delivered a PWA experience without requiring an app download.
Implemented automated testing and deployment scripts on Linux.
Established CI/CD from the start for rapid, repeatable releases.
outcomes: Zero downtime during the first 90 days post-launch.
CI/CD reduced release time from hours to under 15 minutes.
